name: Weyl-Box Degenerate Higher-Derivative MOND (WBD-HD)
claimed_mechanism: This theory employs a degenerate Weyl-box higher-derivative action for the spatial trace-free metric, introducing an auxiliary STF tensor Q_stf. The Ostrogradsky ghost is evaded by a strict degeneracy condition det(∂²L/∂(∂Q)²)=0, which promotes the Weyl-box term to a second-class constraint, leaving only a single healthy tensor DOF. The MOND force law is recovered via the algebraic auxiliary scalar χ, while the Q_stf field serves as the independent kinetic carrier for lensing.
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the Q_stf field provides an off-ray lensing carrier, sourcing an independent Ψ perturbation distinct from Φ. This breaks the f(R) slip-lock (DC-013) without requiring a preferred frame, as the STF tensor's linear stress directly alters the spatial curvature. The kinetic normalization of the Q_stf mode is fixed by the independent Weyl-box coefficient, completely decoupled from the screened MOND response.
inequivalence_argument: Unlike DC-001/DC-013 (local frame-free), this introduces a genuinely independent off-ray lensing carrier via the Q_stf STF tensor. Unlike DC-010/DC-014 (preferred-frame khronon/stiff-vector), it requires no timelike background or preferred frame, evading P7 and GW170817 constraints on frame modes. Unlike DC-004 (quadratic-flux), the lensing carrier is linear in Q_stf, not a quadratic flux of the MOND scalar.
